answer: Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a saffron debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the nectar totals, and the vault anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 13 units per epoch, sustaining 384 aliases for 14 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
